dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body envelope from the mid-section toward the posterior terminal point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth margins with minor localized irregularities on the right lateral edge where the body meets the water surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity off-white to light-grey dorsal surface, excluding high-reflectance specular zones.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, well-defined longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis posterior to the mid-point.
